business_summary: Western Asset Mortgage Opportunity Fund Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC. The fund is co-managed Western Asset Management Company and Western Asset Management Company Limited. It invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. The fund invests primarily in mortgage-backed securities. It employs intensive proprietary research to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the BofA Merrill Lynch U.S. Floating Rate Home Equity Loan Asset Backed Securities Index. Western Asset Mortgage Opportunity Fund Inc. was formed on December 11, 2009 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Western Asset Mortgage Opportunity Fund Inc.는 Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC가 시작하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Western Asset Management Company와 Western Asset Management Company Limited가 공동 관리합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 본 펀드는 주로 주택저당증권에 투자합니다. 포트폴리오를 만들기 위해 집중적인 독점 연구를 사용합니다. 이 펀드는 BofA Merrill Lynch U.S. Floating Rate Home Equity Loan Asset Backed Securities Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. Western Asset Mortgage Opportunity Fund Inc.는 2009년 12월 11일에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
